data.reason: Frozen v1 E1–E6 first-pass assessment. Publisher original article abstract explicitly describes two human-participant driving-simulator experiments comparing text-to-speech, spearcons and auditory icons across background-noise conditions, with warning recognition accuracy and reaction-time outcomes. E1–E6 appear satisfied at title/abstract stage; include solely to seek and verify complete original full text. The publisher HTML visibly exposes selected body sections, but only the Abstract, Current Study, Experiment 1 Method/Participants, and General Discussion were inspected through tool-mediated web rendering; no complete Experiment 2 review, participant-overlap adjudication, audio playback, numeric extraction, raw document custody or hashed manifestation occurred. Two reported experiments are not two independently admitted samples.

Tool-mediated rendered public text; publisher HTTP Date and original HTML/PDF bytes/hash were not captured, reproduction rights not inferred. Existing Crossref verified DOI identity SRC-R006-H-SABIC-UNDERSTANDING@1 was metadata_only; no new manifestation or reader AID registered. Publication DOI has one original discovery occurrence HIT-R005R-C1RECOVERY-EQ1-00046. No human verification, audiovisual inspection, study or participant sample admitted.
